audit.whatIsWrong: Every row of the chart read Skill or Singed while all seven whys describe Vayne winning that stage, and the packet chart is Vayne across the board.
audit.why: Singed has no ranged damage — Poison Trail is a 20-unit trail behind him and Fling reaches 125 units against Condemn's 550. He cannot open on Vayne without walking into her. The already-audited Singed side moved the whole chart to the packet read as one group.
audit.corrected: Vayne on all seven stages, proposed as matched full/content pairs plus the two ratings that contradicted it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 and first-item lines never mentioned Insanity Potion's Grievous Wounds, which is the one thing that blunts a Blade of the Ruined King spike.
audit.why: Insanity Potion is a flat 100s cooldown and makes Poison Trail apply healing reduction, so the lifesteal half of Vayne's item spike is cut while it runs. Final Hour is 100/85/70 and speeds and hides Tumble.
audit.corrected: Fight in the 100s of downtime on Insanity Potion; while it runs, price the fight without the lifesteal.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] told the player to 'Tumble out of Mega Adhesive slows'. Mega Adhesive grounds — it shuts dashes off, so Tumble is exactly what does not work inside it. Nothing recorded that Fling only roots when you land in the goo.
audit.why: Kit: Mega Adhesive slows and grounds enemies who walk on it; Fling 'flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.' The order is goo first, Fling second — that is the tell.
audit.corrected: Never Tumble inside the goo; it grounds. And the moment he throws adhesive, expect the Fling into it.
sources: kit: Mega Adhesive grounding flag and text

edits.before: Kite with autos and never let him touch you. Identify how Singed contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Poison Trail only reaches the ground behind him and costs mana per tick; your autos win the first wave outright.

edits.before: Q tumble resets make your spacing untouchable. Only take the trade when Singed's Fling is down.
edits.after: Fling reaches 125 units, Condemn reaches 550 — step up, hit him, step back outside his grab.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Fling's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Trade around Fling's 10s at rank 1, and never inside Mega Adhesive: the goo grounds you, so Tumble will not take you out.

edits.before: Final Hour stealth-tumbles break every engage pattern onto you. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Singed's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Final Hour speeds and hides your Tumble; his 6 is Insanity Potion, whose Grievous Wounds cuts your lifesteal. Fight anyway.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Fling's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike, but Insanity Potion cuts the lifesteal — fight in its 100s downtime.

edits.before: Final Hour lets you chase him down as he kites with Mega Adhesive and Fling; Condemn him away from his goo so he can't slow you, and the stealth on your R dodges his Fling timing.
edits.after: Final Hour speeds and hides your Tumble while he kites with Mega Adhesive and Fling. Never Tumble inside the goo — it grounds you. Condemn him off it first, then commit to the chase.

edits.before: Tumbling out of Mega Adhesive slows
edits.after: Staying off goo — it grounds Tumble

edits.before: Flinging you into poison and tower
edits.after: Goo down, then Fling you into a root

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Poison Trail costs him almost nothing and ticks the whole chase.

notes: Whole chart moved to the packet read in matched pairs, agreeing with the already-audited Singed side. The biggest live error was wants.you[2] telling the player to Tumble out of Mega Adhesive — the goo grounds, so that instruction gets people killed.
